scoring_time.timestamp_definition: T0=leads.created_at; T1=first inquiries.inquiry_at; T2=second and later inquiries.inquiry_at while no scheduled_visit has already occurred

population.eligibility: Scoring snapshots with a complete 30-day future observation window; T1/T2 are generated only before a known scheduled visit has occurred.
exclusions: Dynamic snapshots after an already observed scheduled visit.
Current/future broker-response information from model inputs.

question: Does a strictly historical, smoothed broker performance prior add incremental signal beyond the existing Lead/Inquiry/Spot feature set?
hypothesis: A point-in-time broker history prior will improve held-out macro AP without using broker identity or future outcomes.
primary_change: add historical broker response/support and smoothed scheduled-visit prior features constructed strictly before each scoring time
secondary_changes: use fixed Laplace Beta(1,1) smoothing rather than full-dataset prevalence
do not use broker_id as a model feature

validation.split_description: Chronological 70/15/15 split by lead creation; every T0/T1/T2 snapshot for a lead is assigned to the same partition. Validation controls early stopping and calibration; test is untouched until final evaluation.

items.evidence: Inherited unchanged from E005; lead_score_internal, current broker outcome/timing and mutable current-state Spot aggregates remain blocked.

items.source: prior inquiries joined to current spot broker
items.evidence: Cumulative broker event history uses searchsorted side=left; current/future response cannot enter.
Only already-realized historical scheduled_visit events are counted.
Rate is (scheduled+1)/(responses+2); smoothing prior is fixed and does not use future prevalence.
Log support is derived from the same strictly historical response count.
Elapsed time starts at the broker's first already-realized response and ends at current score_time.
